birthday.definition: An anniversary of the day on which a person was born (or the celebration of it).

wedding.definition: A marriage ceremony and the celebration associated with it.

anniversary.definition: The date on which an event occurred in some previous year (or the celebration of it).

graduation.definition: The successful completion of a program of study.

retirement-party.definition: A social event held to celebrate someone leaving work at the end of their career.
retirement-party.exampleUsage: Coworkers organized a retirement party for the departing employee.

baby-shower.definition: A social gathering held before or around the birth of a baby, often to celebrate and support the parents.
baby-shower.exampleUsage: Friends attended a baby shower for the expecting parents.

engagement.definition: An agreement between two people to marry.

housewarming.definition: A gathering to celebrate moving into a new home.

promotion.definition: A move to a more senior position at work.

farewell.definition: An acknowledgment or expression of goodwill at parting.

first-day-of-school.definition: The first day a student attends school at the beginning of a school year or new stage.
first-day-of-school.exampleUsage: The child packed a new notebook for the first day of school.

learning-to-drive.definition: The process of gaining the knowledge and supervised practice required to drive legally and safely.
learning-to-drive.exampleUsage: She is learning to drive with a qualified instructor.

first-job.definition: A person's first paid position or regular employment experience.
first-job.exampleUsage: His first job taught him how to work as part of a team.

moving-out.definition: The process of leaving a home or shared residence to live somewhere else.
moving-out.exampleUsage: She packed her belongings before moving out.

buying-a-home.definition: The process of purchasing a house or other residential property.
buying-a-home.exampleUsage: The financial-literacy class discusses the costs involved in buying a home.

getting-married.definition: Entering into a legally or socially recognized marriage.
getting-married.exampleUsage: The family celebrated the couple getting married.

having-a-baby.definition: Becoming a parent through the birth of a child.
having-a-baby.exampleUsage: The story follows a family preparing for having a baby.

career-change.definition: A deliberate move from one line of work into another.

retirement.definition: The state of being retired from one's business or occupation.

traveling-abroad.definition: Traveling to a country other than the one where a person normally lives.
traveling-abroad.exampleUsage: She checked her travel documents before traveling abroad.

loss.definition: The experience of losing someone or something important.

grief.definition: Intense sorrow caused by loss of a loved one (especially by death).

funeral.definition: A ceremony to remember someone who has died, often associated with burial or cremation.

divorce.definition: The legal ending of a marriage.

illness.definition: Impairment of normal physiological function affecting part or all of an organism.

accident.definition: An unexpected event that can cause harm or damage.

moving-away.definition: Leaving a current home or area to live in another place.
moving-away.exampleUsage: The family said goodbye before moving away.

layoff.definition: The loss or suspension of a job because an employer no longer needs the worker, rather than for personal misconduct.

breakup.definition: The termination or disintegration of a relationship (between persons or nations).

recovery.definition: The process of getting better after illness or injury in this life-event context.

award.definition: A tangible symbol signifying approval or distinction.

certificate.definition: An official document confirming an achievement, qualification, or other fact.

diploma.definition: A document certifying the successful completion of a course of study.

degree.definition: An award conferred by a college or university signifying that the recipient has satisfactorily completed a course of study.

medal.definition: An award for winning a championship or commemorating some other event.

trophy.definition: An object, often a cup, awarded for success in a competition or achievement.

scholarship.definition: Financial support awarded to help someone study, under stated eligibility conditions.

publication.definition: The act of making written work available to readers, or the work made available.

patent.definition: A legal right allowing an inventor to control use of an invention for a limited period.

baptism.definition: A Christian sacrament signifying spiritual cleansing and rebirth.

communion.definition: The act of participating in the celebration of the Eucharist.

bar-mitzvah.definition: A Jewish milestone marking a boy reaching religious responsibility, traditionally at age thirteen, often celebrated with a ceremony.
bar-mitzvah.arabicTranslation: بار متسفا: بلوغ المسؤولية الدينية للفتى اليهودي

confirmation.definition: A Christian ceremony affirming a person's commitment to their faith.

graduation-ceremony.definition: A formal school ceremony where graduates receive diplomas or degrees after completing their studies.

inauguration.definition: A ceremony marking the formal start of a person’s public role or the opening of something.

oath.definition: A formal solemn promise, sometimes made when starting a role or promising to tell the truth.

pledge.definition: A serious promise to do something or support a cause.

blessing.definition: Words or an act asking for divine favor or expressing good wishes.

memorial.definition: A ceremony, object, or place created to remember a person or event.
